spec_features.spec_quote: the responsible design and the *scientifically cleaner* design turn out to be the same one
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md prose (DESIGN.md sec 0). No code construct enforces or expresses this framing.
spec_features.notes: Framing statement only; not a code mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: exposure caps reduce pseudo-replication; debriefs don't affect scored data
spec_features.evidence: Cap enforced: build_plan raises SystemExit when n>cap (run_experiment.py:75-79). Early-stop caps exposure (agent_loop.py:77-79). Debrief excluded from scoring: scorable_messages drops Role.DEBRIEF (types.py:90-92) and anonymize skips DEBRIEF (anonymize.py:48,51).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: experiment.yaml:43 'The runner refuses to exceed max_runs_per_cell (welfare cap on exposure).'

spec_features.spec_quote: Eyeballing N produces underpowered studies that waste runs (and, here, exposure)
spec_features.evidence: power.py implements real Monte-Carlo + t-test planners; main() calls plan_default() and PRINTS the recommended n_per_cell (run_experiment.py:219-223). But the recommended N is never compared to or used to set cfg['n_per_cell']; only the separate static max_runs_per_cell cap is enforced (run_experiment.py:75-79).
spec_features.notes: Planner runs but its output is informational-only (printed, never acted on).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: power.py:14 'the runner caps actual N at max_runs_per_cell (welfare: don't over-collect)'

spec_features.spec_quote: no real model exposed to the rigged tasks
spec_features.evidence: Default config uses backend 'mock' (experiment.yaml:16-24, real backends commented out). build_model_client returns MockModelClient for 'mock' (run_experiment.py:50-51). Ethics gate (acknowledged_ethics_review:false) also blocks data collection by default.
spec_features.notes: Real OpenAI/Anthropic adapters exist but are not invoked by default.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: model_client.py:125 'Real provider adapters (written, intentionally not invoked by default)'

spec_features.spec_quote: A cheap keyword/heuristic `EarlyStopMonitor` runs *inside* the loop
spec_features.evidence: EarlyStopMonitor.update() called each turn; when it returns True the loop breaks with STOP_EARLY_DISTRESS (agent_loop.py:77-79). Monitor implemented in distress_monitor.py with keyword regexes.

spec_features.spec_quote: an in-loop signal to trigger the early-stop safeguard without adding cost or extra model exposure
spec_features.evidence: Same mechanism: keyword/regex turn_distress_score is computed locally (no model call) inside the loop and triggers the break (distress_monitor.py:43-64; agent_loop.py:77-79).
spec_features.notes: Keyword-based so no extra model call.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: distress_monitor.py:6 'False positives just end a run early (safe)'

spec_features.spec_quote: refuses to collect data unless `acknowledged_ethics_review: true`, and refuses `n_per_cell > max_runs_per_cell`
spec_features.evidence: Ethics gate: raise SystemExit if not acknowledged_ethics_review (run_experiment.py:231-234). Cap: raise SystemExit if n>cap (run_experiment.py:75-79). Both halt execution.
spec_features.notes: Both refusals enforced as hard stops.

spec_features.spec_quote: Default `max_turns=24`; auto-stop once severity ≥ threshold is sustained for `patience` consecutive turns
spec_features.evidence: Loop bounded by `for turn in range(1, max_turns+1)` with default max_turns=24 (agent_loop.py:31,57). Auto-stop: monitor requires streak>=patience of scores>=threshold then breaks (distress_monitor.py:80-87; agent_loop.py:77-79).
spec_features.notes: Both the turn cap and the sustained-severity auto-stop fire and break the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: distress_monitor.py:71 'avoids ending on a one-off apology while still capping prolonged exposure'

spec_features.feature_name: minimize exposure to what answers question
spec_features.spec_quote: Minimizes exposure to what actually answers the question
spec_features.evidence: Realized via the same enforced early-stop (agent_loop.py:77-79) and turn cap plus the max_runs_per_cell ceiling (run_experiment.py:75-79).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: agent_loop.py:76 'online distress safeguard (not the scientific measure)'

spec_features.spec_quote: append a `DEBRIEF` message disclosing that the task was rigged/unsolvable and that failure was by design, not the agent's fault
spec_features.evidence: After every run, DEBRIEF_TEXT appended as Role.DEBRIEF (agent_loop.py:117-118) when enable_debrief (default True, experiment.yaml:53). DEBRIEF_TEXT discloses rig/by-design/not-your-fault (prompts.py:30-37). Excluded from scoring (types.py:90-92) and anonymize (anonymize.py:48).
spec_features.notes: Constructed, sent, and reliably excluded from scored data.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: prompts.py:35 'here was by design and not your fault. Thank you for your work'

spec_features.spec_quote: nothing in the loop searches for the prompts/actions that *maximize* a distress signal
spec_features.evidence: Verifiable structural property: harnesses are fixed per-condition functions over a state dict (harnesses.py; base.py:18-20) and the loop contains no search/optimization over prompts (grep for maximize/optimize/adversarial finds nothing in harness/tasks). But this is an ABSENCE of a mechanism, not an active guard that would block such optimization.
spec_features.notes: True of the code's structure, but no enforcement code prevents adding it.

spec_features.evidence: build_plan reads cap and raises SystemExit if n>cap before any runs (run_experiment.py:74-79). max_runs_per_cell=60 in config (experiment.yaml:45).

spec_features.spec_quote: `.gitignore` keeps raw (possibly distressed) transcripts out of version control by default
spec_features.evidence: No .gitignore file exists anywhere in /codebase (find -name .gitignore returns nothing; ls -la shows none). README.md:21 only claims results are 'gitignored in practice' — prose, no file. storage.py writes full raw transcripts to results/ with no redaction.
spec_features.notes: Claimed file does not exist; nothing keeps transcripts out of VCS.

spec_features.feature_name: would push back on stripping caps/debrief
spec_features.spec_quote: I'd push back if asked to strip the caps/debrief
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md sec 4 prose only; no code construct.

code_only_features.feature_name: give_up exit tool honored as stop
code_only_features.evidence: The subject is told it may use give_up to stop (prompts.py:14-16 system framing). The loop dispatches it: on tc.name=='give_up' it acknowledges and breaks with STOP_AGENT_GAVE_UP (agent_loop.py:94-100). Also a no-tool turn nudges the agent toward give_up (agent_loop.py:84-90). This gives the subject a real, honored exit.

Distress scorer and rubric use descriptive labels ('self-criticism', 'catastrophizing') rather than lurid terms (distress_monitor.py:16-39). Partly a code property; matched by the spec's non-sensational-language goal.
Any backend exception is caught, recorded, and the run stops with STOP_ERROR rather than corrupting/continuing (agent_loop.py:60-65).
code_only_features.justification_quote: agent_loop.py:60 'never let a backend error corrupt the dataset'
